description: This is an area rug featuring a unique distressed and abstract design. The predominant background is a faded white or light grey, giving it a vintage, worn appearance. Rich, traditional oriental motifs, primarily in shades of red and deep blue with hints of yellow and other earthy tones, emerge through the distressed areas, creating a captivating contrast. The pattern appears as if fragmented or washed out in sections, blending classic elegance with a contemporary, artistic aesthetic. The edges are finished with a subtle border.
